issues.description: The 9,373-edge checklist contains unresolved macro/remote-context reads and external inputs whose exact producer, compatible vintage, or path cannot be established from the supplied workflow and bounded probes. Preserve this gap pending the authors’ complete producer list and schema/path details.

The NIC step writes nic.nic_relationships_20180331, later reads nic.relationships_20180331, and separately writes nic.relationships_names_20180331. The read target has no matching name in these inspected producer lines; confirm intended raw/enriched table before execution.
Step 2b-2 writes box.top_regid_byperiod_2017, while downstream inputs reference top-regulatory-by-period tables; no producer for the legacy box.top_regid_byperiod target is demonstrated.
The code hard-codes Windows Box Sync paths under different user names and directory roots across stages, so the supplied workflow has no configured path mapping for this environment.

The consumer-loan estimation file marks a transfer to WRDS and leaves the concrete transfer instruction as a placeholder; local and remote copies of intermediate data are not linked by a reproducible supplied step.

Step 3 saves box.cecl_dataset as a SAS dataset. Three Stata analyses are supplied, but their entry code has no visible data-load/import step; the intended transfer, dataset reload per script, and correct run order are unspecified.

The complete requested workflow includes all 68 Step 2f sensitivity scripts, but their full producer/input closure is not verified. The author documents a separate main-only branch that skips Step 2f only after removing marked Step 3 variables; that branch is not selected here.

evidence.quote:
The code below gathers data on single-family and multi-family mortgage loan originations by bank from
	1990-2016 filed pursuant to the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA). Mortgage origination data is 
	aggregated in Loan Application Register (LAR) files, which are made available annually and maintained 
	on the FFIEC website. Different procedures are followed for the periods 1990-2003, 2004-2009, and 
	2010-2016 due to changes in the LAR over time. HMDA provides a dataset linking each bank's respondent ID
	to its Federal Reserve RSSID for years after 2003. For years prior to 2003, I manually gathered RSSDID 
	data from the National Information Center (NIC) website based on bank name and city. Data from the NIC
	is also used to determine the top regulatory ID for each bank (i.e., the RSSDID if its ultimate parent).

 ============================================================================================================*/

libname hmda '[redacted-path-92501a4a8b3f]';


/*Infile LAR (HMDA's Loan/Application Register) 1990-2003*/
data hmda.lar_1990;
infile '[redacted-path-c8268146622e]';
input year 1-4 resp_id $ 5-14 agency_code 15 loan_type 16 loan_purp 17 occupancy 18 amount 19-23 action 24 msa 25-28 state 29-30 county 31-33

review_notes: Assessment is limited to the frozen author package, its cached source text, supplied bounded probes and the listed official public product pages. No author code or regression was run.
The package includes extensive SAS/Stata source code and one SPGMI legend workbook, but no prepared final analysis dataset. Analysis-only is therefore unsupported.

All 9,373 frozen dependency IDs are covered below. The requested full workflow includes all 68 Step 2f sensitivity scripts; their unresolved edges are linked to a concrete issue. The author-documented main-only route is retained as an unselected alternative and is not used to classify in-scope dependencies as optional.
Readable local CRSP, Compustat, FF and I/B/E/S catalog probes verify only requested columns and a one-row read, not historical coverage or equivalence to the authors’ WRDS vintage/interface.

The NIC relationship name mismatch, missing legacy top-regulatory producer, hard-coded Windows path differences, WRDS transfer placeholder and SAS-to-Stata handoff remain actionable source/workflow gaps.

The full workflow includes all three supplied Stata analyses: the main tables excluding Table 2, Table 2 future charge-off tests, and Figure 3/Section 6.3 procyclicality. Fresh-dataset reload and script order remain unresolved until author confirmation.
Supplementary Stata software review confirms _gxtile and ranktest are available via successful Stata 18 which probes and author/developer documentation.
